name: sistema-de-trading
description: Sistema de sinais de trading baseado em MMXM (Market Maker Models), SMT Divergence e Time & Price alignment — escala macro (diario/semanal) para swing trading.

scripts.build: node scripts/limpar-next-na-raiz.mjs && tsc -b && npm run build -w @trading/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run build -w @trading/engine && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs apps/engine/test/*.test.mjs apps/dashboard/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.engine:tempo-real: npm run build -w @trading/engine && node apps/engine/dist/index.js tempo-real
